_meta.notes: DAMAGED PDF - NEEDS A HUMAN. The file is structurally corrupt (poppler reports 'Couldn't find trailer dictionary', 'Invalid XRef entry 676', 'Kid object (page 2) is wrong type (null)'). It claims 4 pages but contains only TWO embedded JPEG streams, and pages 1, 3 and 4 render as blank white. Page 2 renders as SCHEDULE B ('Page 3 of 3', Date of Report 6-16-06, page subtotal box $1,749.04 - a Schedule B page subtotal, NOT a summary-page total, so it is not recorded in totals). Carving the second JPEG out of the raw bytes recovers the COVER page, whose top half is readable - title '2006 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate', Russell A. Cannon, REPUBLICAN, Office Sought COUNTY COUNCIL district 5, clerk stamp RECEIVED JUN 19 2006 - but the image degenerates into corrupt scan data from the Type of Report block downward, so report_type, the amendment boxes and the verification signature/date are UNREADABLE (null, not blank). report_date 6-16-06 is taken from the Schedule B page header's 'Date of Report' box, since the verification block is destroyed. NO Summary Page exists in the recoverable data; all totals are null. Ghostscript repair yielded a 1-page file and pdfimages could reach only the Schedule B image.
